Since you didn't reply within 3 days, the out-of-stock fern should have been automatically refunded. The refund goes to your original payment method, and once issued it takes 5-10 business days for cards or 3-5 business days for digital wallets. If you'd rather have it as store credit, that would be instant, but I can't confirm from the policy whether that option is still available after an automatic refund.

I can't see your order's status from here, so if you don't see the refund or the timeframe has passed, send me the order number (LF- plus six digits) and I'll escalate it to a Support Lead.
